key_insight: VeriCUA frames task-completion verification as agentic exploration: checking success by actively investigating the environment rather than relying only on a fixed set of observations.
problem_solved: Computer-using agents need reliable success checks across desktop, mobile, and web tasks. Existing vision-language model judges and generated checking programs can miss relevant evidence because they have only partial access to complex application environments.
method: Treat verification as an active exploration task, as indicated by the paper’s title.
Seek evidence beyond the observations supplied to a passive judge to determine whether the requested outcome was achieved.

impact: More reliable verification could improve training-data curation, agent evaluation, and reinforcement-learning feedback. The supplied excerpt does not include experimental results, so performance gains cannot be assessed.
